Since this evaluation form is supposed to function as an instrument for students to give their instructors some useful feedback, I will not hesitate to kindly state some problems with our instructor's style of lecturing; so she can improve her lecturing skills.

It is impossible to deny that she has a good grasp of the subject, that is, she knows social psychology very well; however, I don't know if she's aware that most students are unable to follow her lectures with full attention, due to some aspects of her style of lecturing. Initially, I think, I have to kindly recommend her to take some public speaking lessons, this can help her to rearrange her voice tone she uses during lectures, then, it would help her students to follow the lectures. Also, most students appeal to lecture slides to access some core information about the course topics. In this course, however, slides do not provide students with that much needed core information, so students struggle -with agony- to reach that information.

Moreover, I don't think that she was pretty generous when grading exams. I suppose I'm not the most dissident student even when I receive insufficient feedback about my mistakes; however, I wasn't satisfied with her way of deducing my grades. It may be because I didn't understand the reason why she did it but I consider this as an unlikely possibility, since most students either don't understand her reasons or find them unfair. So, she was unclear when explaining her reasons to deduce points. I hope she will find a way to clearly state her reasons to deduce points in her later exams.

She is a nice and kind person who loves to teach, for me that's a strong point since we can feel her joy while teaching to us.
